name: AutoDialerCallAssistant
description: Outbound campaign assistant — plays a message, waits for DTMF confirmation, and transfers interested callers.
flow:
flowchart TD A([Outbound Call]) --> B{Callee answers?} B -->|No answer| C([Result: no_answer]) B -->|Answered| D[/Play autodialer_welcome/] D --> E{Wait for DTMF
15s timeout} E -->|Press 1| F([Transfer to destination
Result: transferred]) E -->|Wrong key| E E -->|Timeout| G[/Play goodbye/] G --> H([Hangup
Result: no_interest])
